scope: Proposition 10.5 of the manuscript “Metric descent and rank-preserving contractions” (preprints/Metric-descent-and-rank-preserving-contractions-September-26-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 068 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 35f14f53ac82dc8a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 60. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let K = C(Y ) ⊆ C(X)T be relatively algebraically closed, and let s be an invariant rational section of aL, a > 0, regular on a resolved generic fibre over K. Suppose that, for every j ≥ 0, u ∈ C(X)T , sj u has no poles on primes of X horizontal over K =⇒ u ∈ K. (10.2) Then either a positive multiple of L has a nonzero invariant section, or a contraction to a smaller base preserves these two conditions.
